stories.title: Addio a Sandro Mazzola, l'eterno simbolo della Grande Inter. Lunedì i funerali a Sant'Ambrogio

en.title: Farewell to Sandro Mazzola, the eternal symbol of the Great Inter. Funeral on Monday at Sant'Ambrogio
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, a legendary Inter player who won 4 Italian championships, 2 European Cups, and 2 Intercontinental Cups, has died. He was also Serie A top scorer in 1965 and Champions League top scorer in 1964 with 7 goals.

stories.title: La prima Coppa dei Campioni dell'Inter di Herrera nel 1964: l'Italia correva con Mazzola

en.title: Inter's first European Cup under Herrera in 1964: Italy ran with Mazzola
en.summary: The article recalls Inter's 1964 European Cup victory, noting Mazzola's connection to his father Valentino and his descendants who continue the family legacy.

stories.title: Addio a Sandro Mazzola, l'eterno simbolo della Grande Inter

en.title: Farewell to Sandro Mazzola, the eternal symbol of great Inter
en.summary: The legendary footballer, winner of four league titles and two European Cups with Inter, has passed away. His career included achievements as a leading scorer in Serie A and the European Cup.

stories.title: Mazzola, il calcio italiano piange la leggenda: l’Inter, Zanetti e i club ricordano Sandro

en.title: Mazzola, Italian football mourns the legend: Inter, Zanetti and clubs remember Sandro
en.summary: Italian football institutions including Inter, the national team federation, and the Serie A league have paid tribute to Sandro Mazzola following his death.

stories.title: Morto Sandro Mazzola, il ricordo dell’Inter: “Ha scritto la storia in maniera indelebile”. Tutto il calcio in lutto

en.title: Sandro Mazzola dies, Inter's tribute: "He wrote history indelibly". All of football in mourning
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, an Inter and national team star who was 83 years old, has passed away. Condolences have come from the sports world and institutions.

stories.title: Sandro Mazzola, il figlio del Grande Torino diventato icona dell’Inter

en.title: Sandro Mazzola, son of Grande Torino who became an Inter icon
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, son of Valentino Mazzola, won four Serie A titles and two European Cups during 17 seasons with Inter. He also won the 1968 European Championship with Italy.

stories.title: Sandro Mazzola è morto, bandiera dell’Inter e azzurro meraviglioso: aveva 83 anni

en.title: Sandro Mazzola dies, Inter legend and exceptional Italian player: aged 83
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, son of Valentino and a European champion in 1968 who played for both Inter Milan and the Italian national team, has passed away at 83.
